records.transport_lane: USB 192.0.2.1 to 192.0.2.2 via lab-transport; SSH_CONNECTION verified by the tracked runbook's reachability probe at the build phase (retained lab-reach.txt) and again at the merge phase; the manual build session itself did not log SSH_CONNECTION
records.note: Runbook deviation, recorded as observed: the tracked scripts/second_host_attest.sh --phase build passed the lease gate (free), the candidate binding and the reachability probe, then failed at the bundle step (`git bundle create <file> <bare-sha>` -> "fatal: Refusing to create empty bundle."; git bundle needs a ref, not a bare object id). The build phase was then run by a manual mirror of the tracked phase (checkpoint-local second_host_build_ref.sh, outside the repository) that differs only in bundling the candidate through a temporary ref refs/heads/attest/8d063f0 (created, bundled, deleted; bundle verified) and in sourcing ~/.cargo/env for the non-login lab shell; every lab step (fresh clone from the bundle, detached checkout, HEAD equality, clean-tree test, cargo fetch --locked, make release-candidate-build, --emit-attestation, sha256sum) is the tracked runbook's. The lab build reported REPRODUCIBLE / PASS with artifact ecf51188…, 2,508,082 B, 15 members, manifest f0bd4072…, the same as the primary mint; the attestation was transferred by scp and merged by the tracked script's --phase merge. The bundle-step fix to the tracked script rides the next source change (a script edit now would move the candidate).
